description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of child nodes (tree width) and accuracy@1 for two models. The x-axis is labeled “Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)” and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 7, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy@1 (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 15 to 35, with tick labels at intervals of 5. A blue solid line with circular markers represents GPT-4o, starting at a value of 24.4 at x=1 and decreasing to 31.1 at x=7. A light blue dashed line with cross markers represents Claude-3.Sonnet, starting at a value of 26.7 at x=1 and decreasing to 20.0 at x=7.
